registry.mapping_policy: Exact operation_id plus unique canonical fingerprint; fail closed on zero, duplicate, ambiguous, malformed or semantically incompatible mapping.

terminalized_controls.tenant_ownership: Action discovery carries tenant_id and tenant_slug from active TenantContext; request endpoint is generated from that tenant and revalidated in prepareActionRequest.
terminalized_controls.availability: enabled only when route/action capability checks pass
terminalized_controls.reconciliation_behavior: GET action completes through mutateThenReconcile and the active workspace query refetch must succeed before visible success.

terminalized_controls.tenant_ownership: Action discovery carries active tenant identity; membership lookup is tenant-scoped; wrong-tenant membership resolves 404.
terminalized_controls.availability: permission denial is published into frontend capabilities and rechecked immediately before fetch
terminalized_controls.reconciliation_behavior: Mutation must be followed by authoritative active-list refetch before visible success; refresh failure is surfaced as accepted-but-not-reconciled.

mapped_not_visible_control_denominator.reason: The exact canonical row is service-kind (SiteWebService.AddSiteAsync), so it is not claimed against the 446 visible_control denominator.

mapped_blocked.reason: Canonical operation requires approval, while the current Laravel endpoint dispatches immediately. The action remains fail-closed even when tenant/site/permission identity is valid.

safety_evidence.wrong_tenant: Frontend prepareActionRequest rejects contract tenant mismatch; Laravel test proves foreign membership mutation is 404.
safety_evidence.wrong_site: Context site lookup and SEO endpoint both use tenant-scoped Site query; Laravel test proves foreign-site context and invocation are 404.
safety_evidence.permission: Discovery publishes permission_denied into capabilities and frontend request preparation rechecks permission.
safety_evidence.unavailable: Discovery publishes explicit state/reason; frontend gating disables action and request preparation independently rejects non-enabled state.
safety_evidence.canonical_integrity: ActionContractRegistry::auditCanonicalMappings rejects malformed or duplicate ledger IDs, missing IDs, ambiguous fingerprints, fingerprint/ID mismatch and duplicate registered mappings.
safety_evidence.authoritative_reconciliation: Shared mutateThenReconcile from PR #278 is consumed; visible success occurs only after authoritative refetch.

expected_reconciliation_delta.note: Canonical generated reconciliation outputs were intentionally not edited. The reconciliation owner must rerun classification against this evidence.
